name: An INPS pension of a German citizen living in Germany: Germany's by treaty, taxed as the plan says, with a warning
workings: Treaty art. 19(4): not an Italian citizen, so Germany taxes it; the plan says Italy, which follows it and warns
Pension detrazione (non-residents keep the art. 13 detrazioni): 700 + 1,255 × (28,000 − 20,000.00) / 19,500 = 1,214.87
Addizionale regionale at Lazio's rates (INPS's seat): 1.73% × 20,000.00 = 346.00
